title: AI交易集中：市场参与者，轮动无门？
speaker: Jason Louis

segments.en: Sure I think you're absolutely right in terms of the concentration risks and this is probably most pronounced when it comes to markets like South Korea and Taiwan and to a large extent Japan for the Nikkei 225 index it's also heavily driven by the AI sentiment
segments.zh: 你说得对，集中度风险在韩国、台湾市场最为明显，日本日经225指数也很大程度上受AI情绪驱动。

segments.en: I think in this case what we do notice is that when investors trying to de-risk they try to look across okay what else can I rotate into which presented interesting dilemma because when you look at markets like South Korea and Taiwan they are indeed heavily driven by technology
segments.zh: 我们发现，当投资者试图去风险时，他们会寻找可以轮动的板块，这带来了有趣的困境：韩国和台湾市场确实高度依赖科技。
